goal: Promote online hypotheses into vehicle- and ECU-family-confirmed knowledge without overwriting stronger evidence.

test_fleet_priority.reason: Large Spanish parc; core MQB and cross-VAG reuse
MQB A0 SUV; compare with Ibiza
Strong exact EV route/DID source and known steering-route exception

per_vehicle_sequence: Execute known-route presence phase within budget.
Read identity DIDs; save raw payloads.
Query only model/platform/family candidates in default session.
Record all positive and negative responses, response times and raw payload lengths.
For candidate physical signals, perform controlled human actions (stationary where possible) and timestamp annotations.
Only use research-mode extended session when exact source+fingerprint gate is satisfied.
Compare the same ECU family on a second vehicle before family promotion.

promotion_rules.vehicle_confirmed: One physical SEAT vehicle reproduces route + DID + decoder and controlled behavior.
promotion_rules.multi_vehicle_confirmed: Two or more compatible SEAT vehicles reproduce it.
promotion_rules.family_confirmed: ECU identity/fingerprint matches and decoder is reproduced across two or more vehicles, potentially across VAG brands.
promotion_rules.brand_wide: Requires evidence across multiple platform families; expected to be rare.

recommended_human_tests.test: Low-speed straight-line roll, then gentle left/right turn; compare four wheel channels.
Stationary center->left->center->right; confirm sign, zero and scale.
Stationary repeated light/medium brake presses; correlate pressure response.
Compare displayed/known cold tire pressures; do not deflate tires solely for validation.
Compare with stable independent thermometer after equilibration.
Compare with trusted external measurement where safely possible; observe ignition-state transitions.
Compare with dashboard SOC and charging-state progression; no HV system access required.
